notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only, own tab, no HTTP client used. robots.txt is 'User-Agent: * / Allow: /' with no Claude-specific rule. LOCALE READ: the .com root is a country selector; the storefront read was the /eu/ storefront (EU, English, EUR) at https://royaldesign.com/eu/, which renders natively in English. Every link recorded is a canonical royaldesign.com/eu/ URL. SITE CHANGED SINCE THE PRIOR HOME-DECOR PASS: the old window.__INITIAL_STATE__ productsContainer.totalProducts blob is gone; the site is now a react-router SSR app whose listing counts render client-side from product-api.royaldesign.se/products/search. TREE: union of (a) the /eu/furniture, /eu/outdoor-furniture and /eu/storage mega-menu and tile strips, (b) the category sitemap /eu/sitemap_pages_0.xml (3442 URLs, 118 of them under the three furniture-bearing departments), and (c) the CategoryCode facet returned by the search API for WEBCAT_1 (Furniture, 46 nodes), WEBCAT_2 (Outdoor furniture, 40 nodes) and WEBCAT_9 (Storage, 34 nodes). TRAP 1 GAINS (nav under-reports the tree): the sitemap surfaced /eu/furniture/sofas/sofa-beds (91, missing from the Sofas mega-menu) and two live categories on legacy top-level slugs the nav never links - /eu/brickbord (h1 'Tray table', 17) and /eu/pedestals (h1 'Pedestals', 21). QTY METHOD: qty is totalNumberOfItems / the CategoryCode facet count from product-api.royaldesign.se/products/search, which is the exact endpoint the listing page itself calls to draw its own 'N products' header. Proven equal to the rendered header on three nodes across two departments: /eu/furniture header '4173 products' = WEBCAT_1 facet 4173; /eu/furniture/tables/coffee-tables header '414 products' = WEBCAT_1_1_2 facet 414 (and its 'Page 1 of 9' = ceil(414/48)); /eu/storage/furniture/drawer-unit header '31 products' = WEBCAT_9_1_10 facet 31. Nothing estimated, summed, or copied from a parent. TRAP 2 (a bad slug serving a plausible wrong number): every leaf URL was fetched and checked for HTTP 200 plus an h1 matching the node. Bogus slugs on this site do 404 honestly - /eu/furniture/beds, /eu/furniture/tables/tray-tables, /eu/furniture/tables/pedestals and /eu/furniture/headboards all returned 404 with the 'not able to find the page' h1. TRAP 3 (identity from the slug, not the label): every node is keyed on the WEBCAT category code read from its own page rather than on its display label, which matters here because 'Benches', 'Coffee tables', 'Footstools', 'Serving trolleys', 'Bar stools & stools' and 'Side tables' each exist twice - once indoors, once outdoors - with different codes and different counts. NAMING QUIRK: the search index's label for WEBCAT_9_1_10 is stale ('Hats') while the live page h1 and canonical are 'Drawer Unit', so the site's own h1 wording was used for every row. NO BEDS CATEGORY: the index carries WEBCAT_1_8 'Beds' (65) / WEBCAT_1_8_1 (64), WEBCAT_1_3 'Storage & Shelves' (5) and WEBCAT_1_6_4 'Headboards' (5), but none of them has a listing page - /eu/furniture/beds and /eu/furniture/headboards 404 and neither appears in the sitemap - so they are not emitted as rows. Adult beds are simply not browsable on this storefront; only Kids beds (13) and Sofa beds (91) are. CATEGORY BUCKETS: 'Furniture' covers the Furniture department plus the Storage department's own 'Storage furniture' and 'Hallway storage' furniture children (wardrobe / sideboard / bookcase / TV unit / chest-of-drawers / shoe-cabinet types, all explicitly in scope). 'Outdoor Furniture' is used for the site's own Outdoor furniture department, whose name is the more truthful bucket. EXCLUDED AFTER INSPECTION: Furniture Accessories (chair cushions 62 = textile, furniture upholstery 149, knobs and door handles 323 = furniture parts) and the whole Furniture care branch (58); Outdoor furniture > Garden (outdoor pots and planters 154, lanterns 4, picnic baskets 67, fire baskets 5, garden equipment and accessories), Outdoor textiles (448) and Outdoor kitchens and barbecues (57); Parasols and parasol bases (23, shade equipment rather than furniture); Storage > Small storage in full (boxes 200, wicker baskets 340, wastepaper baskets and pedal bins 172, jewellery boxes 21, newspaper storage 35, firewood storage 13, and 'Flower shelves' 19 whose product titles are plant boxes and planters); Storage > Children's room storage (toy storage 103, kids clothing storage 6, book stands 11 - sampled titles are book holders and boxes); Storage > Clothing storage > 'Wardrobes and hangers' (69), excluded because the sampled product titles are coat hangers, hooks and a 'Mitten Shelf' rather than wardrobes, so the products contradict the node name; Hooks and hangers (284); Hallway storage > Hat racks (79, wall-mounted racks), Umbrella stands (11), Door stops and shoe horns (22). DUPLICATE URL NOT EMITTED: /eu/furniture/storage--shelves is a live alias page whose h1 is 'Storage furniture' and which renders the same WEBCAT_9_1 children as /eu/storage/furniture, so it was dropped rather than duplicated. Colour/material filter pages under storage/furniture (.../ek, /svart, /tra, /vit) were dropped per the filter-page rule. OTHER DEPARTMENTS CHECKED: a furniture-keyword scan over all 3442 sitemap page URLs found no furniture category outside furniture / outdoor-furniture / storage (the only hit was a legacy alias for outdoor chair cushions). This storefront has no bathroom-furniture and no office-furniture department. FACET CAP NOTE: the CategoryCode facet returned 97 / 101 / 94 values for WEBCAT_1 / 2 / 9; every in-scope sitemap URL resolved to a code present in those lists, so nothing was lost to a facet-size cap. INTERRUPTION: one browser tab froze mid-run (a renderer timeout, not a site block); it was closed, a fresh tab opened, and work resumed from the checkpoint. No 403, DataDome, Akamai, CAPTCHA or rate-limit response was seen at any point.
